description: Minimal permissions for the floating meeting reminder card. The card names a meeting and its participants and is the one window that appears without being asked for, so it gets the smallest surface that lets it work: core invoke, event listening, and permission to hide itself. No filesystem, shell, dialog or notification access — it reads its payload and reports every action through Relay's own commands. `core:window:allow-hide` is granted explicitly because it is not in `core:window:default`: the card plays itself out and hides on the press, and without this it would sit on screen as an invisible click-swallowing rectangle until the backend caught up.
